reviews.title: A very good card.
reviews.comment:
This card replaced a Power Color Liquid Devil 6950xt after I broke the acrylic water block while doing some maintenance on it.  I needed a card that was similar in performance and now air cooled (as I was done with water).
The 7800XT is smaller in size and lighter, fits in my Corsair 5000D with plenty of room left over.  It is paired with a AMD 5800X CPU on a MSI B550 Unify-X motherboard.
Installed it, install the latest drivers, ran 3DMark Steel Nomad Benchmark, and then the 20min Steel Nomad Stress Test, went all smooth without issue, no artifacts.  The card was quite and cool.  During the stress test, Max GPU Temps were at 65C, and Max GPU Hotspot was at 87C.  Completed with 99.7% Stability score.
Also this card was only $100 over the MSRP, unlike some other 7800XT cards.  You shouldn't need a GPU holder, as this card is light, but I have small one holding it up.
reviews.author: Dipal P.

reviews.title: A very nice graphics card
reviews.comment: After a lot of time looking around for information on this design I found almost nothing. But it didn’t stray me away from this variant since it came from power color and still looked like it was nice. This turned out to be everything and more I was looking for in a gpu! Had no issues with the install beside windows being a bit for ddu but after so troubleshooting shooting was able to get in and wipe my old nvidia drivers after that downloaded the amd ones and was off running! This card performs great haven’t had it reach over 65c while under a full load, and atleast doubled my performance of my old card. If you are looking into this model I recommend it, but if anything happens to it I’ll update with what went wrong but so far it has exceeded all my expectations.
